note: Free Inyo NF campground in Jeffrey pine forest on the Owens River Road east of US-395, between Mammoth Lakes and June Lake, beside Deadman Creek near the springs at the head of the Upper Owens River. A bear locker at each site. Bring water. OHV/ATV trails in the Lookout Mountain area are nearby. --Claude
summary: Big Springs (Inyo NF): confirmed free, 26 sites, first-come, vault toilets, no water, season ~May 1-Oct 31 (now closed for the season); creekside is a downgrade candidate (creek 50-75 m from the nearest pads, 6-12 m below under trees); OHV-trails mention flagged; pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE CANDIDATE creekside -> not waterfront: per 3DEP, Deadman Creek's channel runs at ~37.7500-37.75025, 6-12 m below the camp terrace and ~50-75 m north of the loop's northern spurs. Imagery shows only a shadowed, tree-lined band there (a possible spring pool ~45 m N of the north turnaround at ~37.7500,-118.9392). No pad has open ground to the water. The stored evidence ('spring pool ... at the NW edge of the loop with pull-in sites adjacent') is not borne out at that distance. The FS page says only 'basecamp for fishing Deadman Creek'. Going down under the default-down rule; the reviewer decides. Proposed evidence: 'Deadman Creek channel 50-75 m N of the northern pull-ins and 6-12 m below them (3DEP 2026-11-26), under pine canopy; no site on open ground at the water; FS: "basecamp for fishing Deadman Creek" -> not waterfront --Claude'.
OHV (flag, not a drop): FS 'a popular basecamp for ... OHV/ATV trails in the Lookout Mountain area'. It is a general pine-forest campground (fishing, Obsidian Dome) with an OHV side, so it stays.
